title: Agri Operation
subtitle: Operation manuals for your crops, and the plans you build from them.
pickFarm: Pick a farm to see its operation manuals.
noAccess: You don't have access to operation manuals on this farm.

catalog.readOnly: Written by the AgriPulse agronomy team. You can change any of it for your own plan without changing the manual.
catalog.empty: No operation manual is published for your crops yet. The agronomy team adds manuals crop by crop.

manual.noActivities: This manual has no activities yet.
manual.fromStartHint: Timed from the date you give each block, not from a growth stage.

plan.phoneReadOnly: On a phone you can view saved plans. Open AgriPulse on a computer to create or edit one.
plan.startHint: Build a plan from the manual you picked in the Catalog, for any of this farm's matching blocks.
plan.pickFirst: Pick an operation manual in the Catalog first.
plan.noSaved: No saved plans on this farm yet.
plan.deleteHint: Its scheduled activities come off the Plan board. Activities already started, done or skipped stay.
plan.deleteFailed: Couldn't delete the plan. Try again.
plan.editing: Editing the saved plan "{{name}}". Saving re-applies it to its blocks.
plan.allocating: Building a plan from {{name}}. Changes stay in this plan; the manual doesn't change.

err.noDate: Every block needs a start date.

blocks.noneMatch: None of this farm's blocks grows this crop and variety. Pick another manual in the Catalog.
blocks.others: {{count}} other blocks can't use this manual

ops.hint: Untick what doesn't apply here, open a row to change its product, dosage or notes, or add your own. These changes are for this plan only.

dates.perennialNote: Activities timed by a growth stage follow each block's own stage dates. The start date times only the activities anchored to it.
dates.annualNote: Activities are timed from each block's start date and its growth stages from planting.
dates.same: Same start date for all blocks
dates.sameHint: Fastest when blocks were prepared together.
dates.per_blockHint: For blocks planted or pruned on different dates.

calendar.hint: Drag a bar, or select it and use the arrow keys or type a date. A dot marks a moved date; it stays moved when you edit the plan later.
calendar.readOnlyHint: Dates as they will be applied.
calendar.rejected: Some blocks no longer grow this crop and variety. Go back and remove them.

done.body: {{created}} activities scheduled across {{blocks}} blocks. They're on each block's Plan board as Scheduled.
done.kept_one: {{count}} activity already under way was kept as it is.
done.kept_other: {{count}} activities already under way were kept as they are.

changes.unknown: This plan was saved before change tracking existed. Edit and save it to compare against future updates.
changes.howToApply: Open the plan with Edit and save it to apply the updated manual.
